Class TUI

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.view.text.TUI
All Implemented Interfaces:
UI
public class TUI extends Object implements UI
The TUI class represents a text-based user interface for interacting with a game system. It provides methods to handle various events and display relevant information and states to players

    • getMeteoriteDescription

      private String getMeteoriteDescription(int[] meteor, int index)
      Generates a description for a meteorite based on its size and direction of arrival.
      Parameters:
      meteor - an array where the first element represents the size of the meteorite (1 for big, any other value for small) and the second element represents the direction of arrival: 0 for top, 1 for right side, 2 for bottom, 3 for left side.
      index - the sequential index of the meteorite used in the description.
      Returns:
      a string describing the meteorite's size, index, and direction of arrival.

    • getShootDescription

      private String getShootDescription(int[] shoot, int index)
      Generates a descriptive string for a specific shoot based on its size and direction.
      Parameters:
      shoot - an array containing shoot details where shoot[0] represents the size (1 for big, anything else for small) and shoot[1] represents the direction (0 for top, 1 for right, 2 for bottom, 3 for left).
      index - the index of the shoot, used in the description for identification.
      Returns:
      a string describing the shoot's index, size, and direction.
